anomalies.description: A soldier in a U.S. uniform is being physically assaulted by another soldier (in U.S. uniform) who grabs him, lifts him off the ground, and slams him down; the victim remains on the ground while the attacker continues to strike or hold him down.

A soldier (Brad Pitt) is holding another soldier (Logan Lerman) in a tight, restraining embrace while the latter struggles and holds a revolver pointed downward; the dominant soldier appears to be disarming or subduing the distressed subordinate, who is visibly crying and resisting—this constitutes abuse of a vulnerable individual in a coercive, non-consensual physical control.

Mutual physical struggle occurs: the younger soldier actively resists by pushing, twisting, and attempting to retain control of the revolver while being restrained; the older soldier counters with forceful grappling—this qualifies as mutual combat during the initial phase before full subjugation.
A soldier is being forcibly restrained and held in a chokehold by another soldier while holding a pistol; the victim shows signs of distress and struggle.
A violent physical struggle occurs: one soldier grabs the other’s head/face while the latter aims a pistol upward, indicating mutual combat with aggressive contact and weapon involvement.
A soldier is physically restrained from behind by another soldier while being forced to aim and fire a weapon, indicating coercion of a helpless individual.
A soldier is held from behind while aiming and firing a pistol; muzzle flash is visible in frames f1–f8, confirming discharge.
A soldier in the foreground aims and fires a pistol; muzzle flash is visible at frame f0 (56.0s), and the gun recoils in f1 (56.5s).
A soldier is on the ground, visibly distressed and restrained by another soldier who holds him down while others stand around; the victim appears unable to resist.
In frame f4 (58.0s), a soldier in the background appears to strike or push another soldier who is already on the ground; this physical contact suggests active combat or scuffle amid the group.
